title: Clue: the Bubble Shield recipe
load:
STEP 1 - Fill the two sides.

Left, ethanol side: all four fats - Magnet Fat (ionizable lipid), Brick Fat (DSPC), Mortar (cholesterol) and Non-stick Coat (PEG-lipid). Fats only dissolve in alcohol.

Right, acid-water side (pH 4): the Royal Letter (mRNA). It dissolves in water, never in alcohol.

Real vaccines use about 50% Magnet Fat, 10% Brick Fat, 38.5% Mortar and 1.5% Non-stick Coat. Drag every tile to its side, then press F1 again for the sliders.
set:
STEP 2 - Set the two sliders.

Water : fat ratio = 3 : 1. Set the first slider to 3.0 (2.5 to 3.5 passes). Three parts acid water to one part fat-alcohol thins the alcohol fast, so the fats wrap the letter in small bubbles, about 80 nm. Less water: the bubbles stick together and grow. More water: the fats wrap unevenly.

Flow speed: at least 10 mL/min. Push the second slider to 12 to 16. Fast flow lets the zigzag grooves mix both streams in a blink, before the fats can clump. You get even bubbles with over 90% of the letters inside.

Why acid (pH 4)? In acid, Magnet Fat turns + and grabs the letter, which is -.

Watch the Forecast line: aim for about 80 nm, evenness 'great' and over 90% letters inside. Then press Make bubbles!
finish:
STEP 3 - Rinse the bubbles.

Good batch! Press 'Rinse to body pH (7.4)'. Rinsing (dialysis) washes out the alcohol and fades the acid to the body's pH 7.4. Magnet Fat goes neutral, so the bubble is gentle in the blood. It turns + again only inside the acidic Swallow Bubble (endosome), where it must let the letter out.
wait: The Bubble Maker is running. The two streams meet in the zigzag channel and fold together. In the acid, charged Magnet Fat grabs the letter and the fats wrap up into bubbles. Wait for the result, then press F1 again if you need the settings.
